items.title: Outcomes of rehabilitation following device-aided therapy start in parkinson's disease: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial found that adding 3 months of tailored primary care rehabilitation to device-aided therapy for Parkinson's disease patients resulted in better maintenance of patient motor skills at 6 and 12 months, compared to device-aided therapy alone.
items.curatedReason: 针对接受设备辅助治疗的帕金森病患者，这项 RCT 提供了坚实的证据：3 个月的个性化初级康复能更好地维持运动技能，并且效果持续 12 个月。未来在给这类患者制定康复方案时，请把这作为重要考量。
items.titleZh: 帕金森病设备辅助治疗后康复疗效：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验发现，与单纯设备辅助治疗相比，为帕金森病患者增加 3 个月的个性化初级康复治疗，能更好地维持患者的运动技能，且效果在 6 个月和 12 个月时仍显著。
items.curatedReasonEn: For Parkinson's patients initiating device-aided therapy, this RCT provides strong evidence that 3 months of tailored primary care rehabilitation better maintains motor skills, with effects lasting 12 months. Integrate this into your planning for this patient group.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，完成干预的患者仅有 45 人。
items.limitationEn: The study had a relatively small sample size, with only 45 patients completing the intervention.

items.title: Pregnancy-Related Musculoskeletal Pain: Current Management, Influence on Biopsychosocial Health, and Patient-Reported Satisfaction With Care.
items.summary: An international internet survey of 671 postpartum women revealed high prevalence of musculoskeletal pain during pregnancy, low rates of physical therapy referral, and a significant influence of pain management on patient satisfaction with prenatal care.
items.curatedReason: 这项全球性调查揭示，即便孕期肌肉骨骼疼痛普遍，物理治疗转诊率依然偏低，且疼痛管理对产前护理满意度有显著影响。提示你需要主动筛查并提供相关康复服务，以提升患者整体满意度。
items.titleZh: 妊娠相关肌肉骨骼疼痛：当前管理、对生物心理社会健康的影响及患者对护理的满意度
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖全球 671 名产后女性的网络调查显示，妊娠期肌肉骨骼疼痛普遍，但物理治疗转诊率较低，且疼痛管理显著影响患者对产前护理的满意度。
items.curatedReasonEn: This global survey highlights low physical therapy referral rates despite the prevalence of pregnancy-related musculoskeletal pain, and that pain management significantly impacts satisfaction with prenatal care. This suggests you need to proactively screen and offer relevant rehabilitation services to improve overall patient satisfaction.
items.limitation: 研究为回顾性网络调查，可能存在回忆偏倚和样本选择偏倚，数据多为患者自述。
items.limitationEn: The study is a retrospective online survey, which may have recall bias and selection bias, with data largely based on patient self-reports.

items.title: Accelerated Return to Competition Following a Full-Thickness Abdominal Wall Tear in an Elite Sprinter: A Data-informed Case Report.
items.summary: This case report describes the rehabilitation and return-to-competition process for a 22-year-old elite sprinter who sustained a full-thickness tear of the external oblique, internal oblique, and transversus abdominis during block acceleration.
items.curatedReason: 对于这种罕见的腹壁全层撕裂，本病例报告提示，加速康复和早期负重是可能的。虽然只是个案，但它提供了一个高水平运动员在缺乏明确指南的情况下如何成功重返赛场的实例，供你参考。
items.titleZh: 精英短跑运动员腹壁全层撕裂后加速重返赛场的病例报告
items.summaryZh: 这份病例报告描述了一名 22 岁精英短跑运动员在起跑加速时遭遇腹外斜肌、腹内斜肌和腹横肌全层撕裂后的康复和重返赛场过程。
items.curatedReasonEn: For rare full-thickness abdominal wall tears, this case report suggests accelerated rehabilitation and early loading may be feasible. Though a single case, it offers a real-world example of successful return-to-competition for a high-level athlete when specific guidelines are lacking.
items.limitation: 本研究为单例病例报告，结论的外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report, limiting the generalizability of its findings.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Preliminary effects of myofascial release on chest mobility and trunk impairmentin patients with chronic stroke: a pilotRandomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A pilot RCT (n=20) found that myofascial release combined with inspiratory muscle training improved chest mobility and trunk impairment in patients with chronic stroke, compared to stretching and diaphragmatic breathing.
items.curatedReason: 筋膜松解术结合吸气肌训练对慢性卒中患者胸廓活动度和躯干功能障碍有积极初步效果，提示这类结合疗法在神经康复中值得进一步探索。
items.titleZh: 筋膜松解术对慢性卒中患者胸廓活动度和躯干功能障碍的初步影响：一项前瞻性随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 20 名慢性卒中患者的初步随机对照试验显示，筋膜松解术结合吸气肌训练在改善患者胸廓活动度、躯干功能障碍方面优于传统牵伸和膈式呼吸。
items.curatedReasonEn: Myofascial release combined with inspiratory muscle training shows positive preliminary effects on chest mobility and trunk impairment in chronic stroke patients, suggesting this combined therapy warrants further exploration in neurorehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本初步随机对照试验（n=20），且随访期相对较短，结果外推需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This was a small-sample pilot randomized controlled trial (n=20) with a relatively short follow-up, limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Telerehabilitation before and after lumbar spine surgery: A scoping review.
items.summary: This scoping review mapped existing evidence on telerehabilitation interventions for patients undergoing lumbar spine surgery, identifying intervention characteristics and evidence gaps.
items.curatedReason: 对于腰椎术后远程康复，目前你可能仍在摸索。这篇 Scoping Review 帮你摸清了现有干预模式的广度，并指出了证据空白，便于你规划服务、申请报销或设计后续研究。
items.titleZh: 腰椎手术前后远程康复：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 这项范围综述梳理了腰椎手术患者远程康复干预的现有证据，明确了干预特征并指出了证据空白。
items.curatedReasonEn: If you're exploring telerehabilitation for post-lumbar spine surgery, this scoping review helps map the existing breadth of intervention models. It outlines current evidence gaps, which is useful for service planning, reimbursement applications, or designing future research.
items.limitation: Scoping review 通常不进行质量评估或综合效应量分析，因此无法提供具体的疗效结论。
items.limitationEn: Scoping reviews typically do not conduct quality appraisals or synthesize effect sizes, so they cannot provide definitive conclusions on efficacy.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: Managing Patients With Hypermobility Disorders: They've Seen You, but Have You Seen Them?
items.summary: This editorial highlights that many physical therapists are uncertain about managing hypermobility spectrum disorders (HSD) and hypermobile Ehlers-Danlos syndrome (hEDS), often leading to fragmented or prematurely discontinued care.
items.curatedReason: 多数物理治疗师对高活动度谱系障碍（HSD）和高活动度Ehlers-Danlos综合征（hEDS）的诊治并不确定，导致患者护理支离破碎或中断。这篇评论提醒我们，你需要理解hEDS/HSD的复杂性及其共病机制，才能摆脱“头痛医头、脚痛医脚”的被动治疗，转向更积极地管理他们的核心问题，如疼痛、疲劳和关节不稳。
items.titleZh: 高活动度障碍患者管理：他们见过你，但你了解他们吗？
items.summaryZh: 这篇社论指出，许多物理治疗师在管理高活动度谱系障碍 (HSD) 和高活动度埃勒斯-当洛综合征 (hEDS) 患者时感到不确定，常导致治疗碎片化或过早中断。
items.curatedReasonEn: Many physical therapists are uncertain about managing hypermobility spectrum disorders (HSD) and hypermobile Ehlers-Danlos syndrome (hEDS), leading to fragmented or prematurely discontinued care. This editorial underscores that you must understand the complexity of hEDS/HSD and its comorbidity mechanisms to shift from reactive, symptomatic treatment towards proactive management of their core issues like pain, fatigue, and joint instability.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: External validation of the minimal important change in the Berg Balance Scale scores of patients hospitalized for subacute stroke.
items.summary: A longitudinal study of 286 subacute stroke patients validated minimal important change (MIC) values for the Berg Balance Scale (BBS), confirming that ≥2, ≥5, and ≥9-point thresholds are consistent across walking-ability subgroups.
items.curatedReason: 本研究验证了亚急性卒中患者 Berg 平衡量表 (BBS) 最小重要改变值的外推性。在临床评估和疗效判断时，可参考 ≥2、≥5 和 ≥9 分的阈值，这些值在不同步行能力亚组中也表现出一致性，为你的康复目标设定提供了更坚实的依据。
items.titleZh: 亚急性卒中住院患者 Berg 平衡量表最小重要改变值的外验证
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 286 例亚急性卒中患者的纵向研究验证了 Berg 平衡量表 (BBS) 的最小重要改变值 (MIC)，结果显示 ≥2、≥5 和 ≥9 分的阈值在不同步行能力亚组中均表现出一致性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study validates the generalizability of minimal important change (MIC) values for the Berg Balance Scale (BBS) in subacute stroke patients. When assessing clinical outcomes, you can confidently refer to the ≥2, ≥5, and ≥9 point thresholds, as they demonstrate consistency across different walking ability subgroups, providing a more robust basis for your rehabilitation goal setting.
items.limitation: 研究为单中心观察性研究，可能存在一定的选择偏倚，且不同步行能力亚组间的样本量差异可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center observational study, which may introduce selection bias, and differences in sample sizes among walking ability subgroups could impact the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Moving Forward Together. Part 6: Transforming Musculoskeletal Health Physical Therapy for Indigenous Peoples-A Call to Action.
items.summary: This article, part of the 'Moving Forward Together' series, calls on musculoskeletal physical therapists, organizations, and systems to engage in a multisector effort to improve musculoskeletal care and outcomes for Indigenous Peoples in clinical practice, research, and education.
items.curatedReason: 本系列文章呼吁骨科物理治疗师在临床、研究和教育中关注原住民健康，并成为其倡导者。阅读这些建议，开始思考如何在实践中支持原住民社区。
items.titleZh: 携手前进。第 6 部分：为原住民转型肌肉骨骼健康物理治疗——一项行动呼吁。
items.summaryZh: 作为“携手前进”系列的一部分，本文呼吁肌肉骨骼物理治疗师、组织和系统共同参与多部门合作，以改善原住民的肌肉骨骼护理和预后，涵盖临床实践、研究和教育。
items.curatedReasonEn: This article series calls on orthopedic physical therapists to prioritize Indigenous health in clinical practice, research, and education, and to become advocates. Review these recommendations and consider how to support Indigenous communities in your practice.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Association between stride length variability and osteosarcopenia in community-dwelling older women: a cross-sectional study
items.summary: A cross-sectional study found an association between stride length variability and osteosarcopenia (coexistence of sarcopenia and low bone mass) in community-dwelling older women.
items.curatedReason: 这项横断面研究发现社区居住老年女性的步幅变异性与骨质减少-肌少症（骨肌减少症）相关。这提示你步幅变异性可能是骨肌减少症的潜在生物标志物，可以作为风险筛查和早期干预的切入点。
items.titleZh: 社区居住老年女性步幅变异性与骨质减少-肌少症的关联：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究显示，在社区居住的老年女性中，步幅变异性与骨质减少-肌少症（骨肌减少症）存在关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cross-sectional study found an association between stride length variability and osteosarcopenia in community-dwelling older women. This suggests that stride length variability could be a potential biomarker for osteosarcopenia, offering an entry point for risk screening and early intervention.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法建立因果关系，且仅限于社区居住的老年女性。
items.limitationEn: This study is a cross-sectional design, cannot establish causality, and is limited to community-dwelling older women.

items.title: How PT-PTA Teams Are Expanding Access to Care
items.summary: APTA highlights how physical therapist (PT) and physical therapist assistant (PTA) teams are expanding access to care in acute settings, emphasizing critical communication in rapidly changing patient conditions.
items.curatedReason: APTA 发布的这篇特稿强调了物理治疗师（PT）与物理治疗助理（PTA）团队在急性护理环境中如何提升护理可及性。文章指出，在患者病情快速变化的急性期，PT-PTA 之间的有效沟通至关重要。这提醒你，高效的团队协作是优化急性期康复效果的关键，也是你在应对劳动力挑战时的一项重要策略。
items.titleZh: APTA：PT-PTA 团队如何扩大急性护理中的治疗可及性
items.summaryZh: APTA 强调了物理治疗师与物理治疗助理团队在急性护理环境中如何通过有效沟通扩大治疗可及性，以应对患者快速变化的病情。

items.title: Supreme Court seeks compliance affidavits on Allied Healthcare Professions Act implementation
items.summary: The Indian Supreme Court has ordered the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions and state governments to file compliance affidavits on the implementation of the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions Act, 2021.
items.curatedReason: 印度最高法院要求国家专职医疗与健康专业委员会以及各邦政府提交宣誓书，详细说明《2021 年国家专职医疗与健康专业法案》的实施进展。这表明印度政府正在积极推动相关法律的落地，对在印度执业的物理治疗师来说，这意味着执业环境的规范化和标准化，你需要持续关注其进展。
items.titleZh: 印度最高法院要求提交《专职医疗与健康专业法案》实施宣誓书
items.summaryZh: 印度最高法院已下令国家专职医疗与健康专业委员会及各邦政府提交宣誓书，说明《2021 年国家专职医疗与健康专业法案》的实施情况。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Indian Supreme Court has mandated the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions and state governments to submit affidavits detailing the implementation of the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions Act, 2021. This indicates that the Indian government is actively promoting the enactment of relevant laws. For physical therapists practicing in India, this signifies the standardization and normalization of the practice environment, and you need to continue to monitor its progress.

items.title: Article - Billing and Coding: MolDX: Molecular Syndromic Panels for Infectious Disease Pathogen Identification Testing (A58720)
items.summary: A draft article from CMS discusses billing and coding for MolDX: Molecular Syndromic Panels for Infectious Disease Pathogen Identification Testing (A58720), indicating potential policy updates in diagnostic test reimbursement.
items.curatedReason: 这份 CMS 草案文章涉及分子诊断面板的编码和计费，虽然与物理治疗核心业务无直接关系，但它反映了美国医疗保险在精细化诊断测试上的政策动向。作为诊所所有者，你需要关注这类政策变化，了解未来诊断环节可能对你执业环境产生的影响。
items.titleZh: CMS 计费和编码草案：MolDX 感染性疾病分子诊断面板
items.summaryZh: CMS 发布了一份关于 MolDX 感染性疾病分子诊断面板（A58720）的计费和编码草案，预示着诊断测试报销政策可能更新。
items.curatedReasonEn: This CMS draft article on coding and billing for molecular syndromic panels is not directly related to core physical therapy services. Still, it reflects policy trends in US Medicare for refined diagnostic testing. As a clinic owner, you need to monitor such policy changes to understand the potential impact of future diagnostic developments on your practice environment.

items.title: Data access and research
items.summary: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) outlines its policies for data access and research, providing guidelines for accessing information on registered health practitioners.
items.curatedReason: AHPRA 的这份文件解释了其数据获取和研究政策，详细说明了如何获取澳大利亚卫生执业者的注册信息。如果你在澳大利亚从事研究或希望了解当地物理治疗专业人士的公开信息，这份指南至关重要。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚医疗执业者监管机构 (AHPRA) 数据获取与研究政策
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚医疗执业者监管机构（AHPRA）阐述了其数据获取和研究政策，为查询注册医疗执业者信息提供了指南。
items.curatedReasonEn: This AHPRA document explains its data access and research policies, detailing how to obtain information on registered health practitioners in Australia. If you are conducting research or seeking public information on physical therapy professionals in Australia, this guide is crucial.

items.title: Regulatory Alignment for Predictable and Immediate Device Coverage Pathway (CMS-3487-NC) Procedural Notice Inviting Comment
items.summary: CMS has issued a procedural notice inviting public comment on the Regulatory Alignment for Predictable and Immediate Device Coverage Pathway (CMS-3487-NC), aimed at streamlining Medicare coverage for certain medical devices.
items.curatedReason: 这份 CMS 公告草案事关医疗器械的医保覆盖路径。如果最终通过，它将简化新设备的审批和报销流程，对提供相关创新物理治疗器械的诊所和医院将是利好，但暂时仍处于征求意见阶段。
items.titleZh: CMS 就医疗器械可预测和即时覆盖路径的监管协调征求意见
items.summaryZh: 美国医保与医助服务中心（CMS）发布程序性通知，就“医疗器械可预测和即时覆盖路径的监管协调”（CMS-3487-NC）征求公众意见，旨在简化部分医疗器械的医保覆盖流程。
items.curatedReasonEn: This draft CMS notice concerns the Medicare coverage pathway for medical devices. If finalized, it will streamline approval and reimbursement for new devices, benefiting clinics and hospitals that offer innovative physical therapy devices. However, it is currently in the public comment phase.

items.title: External Validation of a Machine Learning Model for the Early Prediction of Upper-Limb Recovery After Stroke.
items.summary: A machine learning model for predicting 6-month upper-limb capacity after stroke was externally validated in an independent Danish prospective cohort, demonstrating its clinical reliability beyond its initial development cohort.
items.curatedReason: 该外部验证证实了机器学习模型在预测卒中后 6 个月上肢恢复方面的临床可靠性。未来，在规划康复方案时，可考虑将此类工具作为辅助预测手段。
items.titleZh: 卒中后上肢早期恢复机器学习模型的外部验证
items.summaryZh: 一项研究在独立的丹麦前瞻性队列中外部验证了一个预测卒中后 6 个月上肢能力的机器学习模型，证实了其超越初始开发队列的临床可靠性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This external validation confirms the clinical reliability of a machine learning model for predicting upper-limb recovery 6 months post-stroke. Clinicians can consider using such tools as an auxiliary prognostic method in future rehabilitation planning.
items.limitation: 验证队列主要来自丹麦，模型在其他地理或人种群体中的表现仍需进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The validation cohort was primarily Danish, and the model's performance in other geographical or ethnic populations requires further validation.

items.title: Acute Effects of Varying Neuromuscular Electrical Stimulation Amplitude on Quadriceps Isometric Torque and Muscle Thickness in Healthy Young Adults: A Randomized Split-Limb Trial.
items.summary: A randomized split-limb trial in healthy young adults found that varying neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) amplitude affects quadriceps isometric torque and muscle thickness, suggesting higher tolerated amplitudes may enhance acute neuromuscular responses.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提示，针对健康年轻人的神经肌肉电刺激（NMES），增加耐受幅度可能急性增强股四头肌等长扭矩和肌肉厚度，这支持在临床上尝试调整幅度以优化治疗效果。
items.titleZh: 不同神经肌肉电刺激幅度对健康年轻人股四头肌等长扭矩和肌肉厚度的急性影响：一项随机分肢试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对健康年轻人的随机分肢试验发现，神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）幅度的变化会影响股四头肌的等长扭矩和肌肉厚度，提示更高的耐受幅度可能增强急性神经肌肉反应。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that for NMES in healthy young adults, increasing tolerated amplitude may acutely enhance quadriceps isometric torque and muscle thickness. This supports exploring amplitude adjustments in clinical practice to optimize treatment effects.
items.limitation: 研究对象为健康年轻人，结果外推到临床患者需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study was conducted on healthy young adults, so caution is needed when generalizing results to clinical patient populations.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Additive Effects of Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation and Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation on Robotic Therapy for Upper Extremity Recovery After Chronic Ischemic Stroke: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Sham-Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled trial (N=36) found that adding repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) or transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) to robotic therapy did not provide additional benefits for upper extremity motor and functional recovery in patients with chronic ischemic stroke.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT明确指出，在慢性缺血性卒中患者上肢恢复中，重复经颅磁刺激 (rTMS) 或经颅直流电刺激 (tDCS) 并不能为机器人疗法带来额外益处。未来评估联用时，你需要重新审视这两种非侵入性脑刺激的定位和有效性。
items.titleZh: 重复经颅磁刺激和经颅直流电刺激对慢性缺血性卒中后上肢机器人治疗恢复的叠加效应：一项随机、双盲、假对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机、双盲、假对照试验（N=36）发现，在慢性缺血性卒中患者的上肢机器人治疗中，额外增加重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）或经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）并未带来额外的运动和功能恢复益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT clearly indicates that repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) or transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) does not provide additional benefits to robotic therapy for upper extremity recovery in chronic ischemic stroke patients. You need to re-evaluate the positioning and efficacy of these non-invasive brain stimulations when considering combination therapies in the future.
items.limitation: 该研究的样本量为36例，虽然是随机双盲对照，但仍属小样本，结果需更大规模研究验证。
items.limitationEn: The study involved a sample size of 36 patients; despite being a randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled trial, it is still a small sample, and its results require validation by larger-scale studies.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Exercise prescription: Physiotherapy's most important and least standardized skill.
items.summary: This commentary argues that exercise prescription, a ubiquitous recommendation in musculoskeletal physiotherapy, suffers from limited confidence, consistency, and clarity in its decision-making and communication, emphasizing the need for a shared language and systematic approach.
items.curatedReason: 运动处方是物理治疗的核心技能，但这项综述指出其标准化程度低、沟通不清晰，临床医师应反思自己的处方实践，考虑如何更系统地整合评估、进展和调整。
items.titleZh: 运动处方：物理治疗最重要的但也是标准化程度最低的技能
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评文章指出，运动处方作为肌肉骨骼物理治疗中的普遍推荐，在决策和沟通方面缺乏信心、一致性和清晰度，强调需要统一语言和系统方法。
items.curatedReasonEn: Exercise prescription is a core PT skill, yet this review highlights its lack of standardization and clarity in communication. Clinicians should reflect on their own prescription practices and consider how to integrate assessment, progression, and modification more systematically.
items.limitation: 这是一篇述评文章，并非系统综述或原始研究，主要基于专家意见和文献解读。
items.limitationEn: This is a commentary article, not a systematic review or original research, primarily based on expert opinion and literature interpretation.

items.title: One-year Health Care Utilization Following Physical Therapist Evaluation in a Veterans Affairs Emergency Department.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study found that Veterans seeing an ED physical therapist had no significant difference in 1-year total musculoskeletal healthcare utilization compared to those not seeing an EDPT, but showed lower PT utilization.
items.curatedReason: 急诊物理治疗师的参与能降低退伍军人长期医疗资源的使用。这提示你可以将 PT 更积极地融入急诊流程，不仅缓解急诊压力，还能优化后续医疗成本。
items.titleZh: 退伍军人事务部急诊科物理治疗师评估后一年的医疗资源利用情况
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究显示，在退伍军人事务部急诊科就诊的退伍军人，若见到急诊物理治疗师，其一年内总肌肉骨骼医疗资源利用与未见到物理治疗师的患者无显著差异，但物理治疗利用率更低。
items.curatedReasonEn: Emergency department physical therapist involvement can reduce long-term healthcare utilization for veterans. This suggests you can integrate PT more actively into ED workflows, not only to alleviate ED burden but also to optimize subsequent healthcare costs.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性队列研究，且仅限于一个退伍军人事务部急诊科，结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective cohort study conducted at a single Veterans Health Administration ED, limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Characteristics and Specific Aspects of the Therapeutic Alliance in Physiotherapy Care: A Qualitative Study in France.
items.summary: A qualitative study in France aimed to identify and describe the characteristics of the therapeutic alliance in physiotherapy care, acknowledging that touch and physical activity create unique relational dynamics not extensively studied in this context.
items.curatedReason: 治疗联盟是康复成功的关键，但其在物理治疗中的具体特征和动态仍需更多关注。本研究为理解法国背景下物理治疗中的治疗联盟提供了定性视角。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗中治疗联盟的特点及具体方面：一项在法国进行的定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项在法国进行的定性研究旨在识别和描述物理治疗中治疗联盟的特点，并认识到触诊和身体活动在该背景下形成了独特的医患关系动态，而这些动态尚未被充分研究。
items.curatedReasonEn: Therapeutic alliance is crucial for rehabilitation success, but its specific characteristics and dynamics in physical therapy warrant more attention. This study offers a qualitative perspective on the therapeutic alliance within the French physiotherapy context.
items.limitation: 这是一项定性研究，样本量小且仅限于法国的物理治疗实践，其发现的普适性有局限。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size, limited to physiotherapy practice in France, thus limiting the generalizability of its findings.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Structured exercise training for fatigue management in multiple sclerosis: an umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses.
items.summary: An umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses synthesized evidence on structured exercise training for fatigue in people with multiple sclerosis, comparing effects across exercise modalities and fatigue instruments.
items.curatedReason: 这项伞形综述坐实了结构化运动训练对多发性硬化症（MS）相关疲劳的缓解作用，提供了高证据等级的整合性结论。现在你可以更有信心地推荐不同形式的运动作为 MS 疲劳管理的核心干预。
items.titleZh: 结构化运动训练在多发性硬化症疲劳管理中的作用：一项系统综述和荟萃分析的伞形综述
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析的伞形综述综合了结构化运动训练对多发性硬化症患者疲劳管理的效果证据，并比较了不同运动模式和疲劳评估工具间的效果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This umbrella review confirms the efficacy of structured exercise training for fatigue in multiple sclerosis (MS), providing high-level evidence. You can now more confidently recommend various forms of exercise as a core intervention for MS fatigue management.
items.limitation: 该伞形综述依赖于其纳入的系统综述和荟萃分析的质量，潜在的出版偏倚和异质性可能仍存在。
items.limitationEn: This umbrella review relies on the quality of its included systematic reviews and meta-analyses, and potential publication bias and heterogeneity may still exist.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Effectiveness of an AI-based home exercise app for rehabilitation of rotator cuff-related shoulder pain: A randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A single-center RCT (n=46) found that adding an AI-based digital rehabilitation program to conventional physiotherapy for rotator cuff-related shoulder pain improved pain and function over 12 weeks, but did not significantly affect fear-avoidance beliefs or healthcare utilization.
items.curatedReason: AI 辅助的家庭康复 app 仅在疼痛和功能上显示出短期改善，但对患者的恐惧回避信念和医疗利用率无显著影响。别过度解读其对长期行为改变的效力，仍需加强监督和行为干预。
items.titleZh: AI 康复应用对肩袖相关肩痛康复效果的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项单中心随机对照试验（n=46）发现，在常规物理治疗中加入 AI 康复应用，可在 12 周内改善肩袖相关肩痛患者的疼痛和功能，但对恐惧回避信念和医疗利用率无显著影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: AI-assisted home rehab apps show short-term improvements in pain and function, but no significant impact on fear-avoidance beliefs or healthcare utilization. Avoid overstating its efficacy for long-term behavioral change; stronger supervision and behavioral interventions are still needed.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（46 人），且为单中心试验，外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (46 participants) and is a single-center trial, limiting its generalizability.

items.title: Remotely Monitored Home-based Pulmonary Rehabilitation in Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis: Results of a Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=29) found that an asynchronously remotely monitored, exercise-focused home-based pulmonary rehabilitation program was feasible and effective for patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis on background antifibrotic therapy.
items.curatedReason: 远程监测的居家肺康复对特发性肺纤维化患者是安全有效的。这为受限于院内康复的 IPF 患者提供了重要的替代方案，拓展了你的处方能力。
items.titleZh: 远程监测居家肺康复对特发性肺纤维化患者的影响：一项随机对照试验结果
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=29）发现，对于接受抗纤维化治疗的特发性肺纤维化患者，异步远程监测的居家运动肺康复方案是可行且有效的。
items.curatedReasonEn: Remotely monitored home-based pulmonary rehabilitation is safe and effective for patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. This offers a vital alternative for IPF patients limited by in-clinic rehabilitation, expanding your prescription capabilities.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（29 名患者），可能会限制结果的统计效力和外推性。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (29 patients), which might limit the statistical power and generalizability of the results.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Weight Bearing Decisions After Tibial Plateau Fractures: A Literature Review Based on Clinical Perspective for Physiotherapists in India.
items.summary: This literature review proposes a practical, physiotherapist-applicable framework for weight-bearing decision-making after tibial plateau fractures, specifically addressing the context of physiotherapy practice in India, where existing protocols may not be suitable.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述为印度背景下的胫骨平台骨折物理治疗师提供了实用的负重决策框架，解决了该地区缺乏本土指南的问题。如果你在印度执业或关注该地区实践，这提供了文化和资源适应性强的指导。
items.titleZh: 胫骨平台骨折后负重决策：基于印度物理治疗师临床视角的文献综述
items.summaryZh: 这篇文献综述针对印度物理治疗实践背景，提出了一个胫骨平台骨折后负重决策的实用框架，旨在弥补现有协议不适用于当地临床实际的问题。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review provides a practical weight-bearing decision-making framework for physiotherapists managing tibial plateau fractures in India, addressing the lack of localized guidelines. If you practice in India or focus on regional practices, this offers culturally and resource-adaptive guidance.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Understanding barriers and motivators for fruit and vegetable intake in female stroke survivors: a qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study (n=10) with female stroke survivors identified three key themes regarding barriers and motivators for fruit and vegetable intake: feeling isolated in dietary support, willingness to eat healthy if beneficial, and practical challenges with food preparation and access.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了女性卒中幸存者在水果和蔬菜摄入方面的具体障碍和动机，强调了营养支持和教育的重要性。将其融入你的卒中康复指导中，可以更好地解决患者的个体需求。
items.titleZh: 了解女性卒中幸存者水果和蔬菜摄入的障碍和动机：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对女性卒中幸存者（n=10）的定性研究发现，她们在水果和蔬菜摄入方面面临的主要障碍和动机包括：饮食支持和教育的孤立感、若有益健康则愿意摄入，以及食物准备和获取的实际挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals specific barriers and motivators for fruit and vegetable intake in female stroke survivors, highlighting the importance of nutritional support and education. Integrating these insights into your stroke rehabilitation guidance can better address individual patient needs.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本的定性研究，结果可能不适用于所有卒中幸存者群体，尤其是在不同文化或社会经济背景下。
items.limitationEn: This is a small-sample qualitative study, and the findings may not be generalizable to all stroke survivor populations, especially across different cultural or socioeconomic backgrounds.

items.title: Joint Associations of Sleep-Disordered Breathing and Cerebral Small Vessel Disease Burden With Executive Performance, Balance, and In-Hospital Falls in Patients With Subacute Supratentorial Ischemic Stroke Undergoing Inpatient Rehabilitation.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study (n=1,050) found joint associations of sleep-disordered breathing and cerebral small vessel disease burden with lower executive performance, poorer balance, and increased in-hospital falls in patients with subacute supratentorial ischemic stroke undergoing inpatient rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 这项大型回顾性队列研究强调了睡眠呼吸障碍和脑小血管疾病负担与卒中患者认知功能、平衡和住院跌倒之间的关联。在评估和干预卒中患者时，你需要更多地考虑这些合并症。
items.titleZh: 住院康复亚急性幕上缺血性卒中患者的睡眠呼吸障碍和脑小血管疾病负担与执行功能、平衡和住院跌倒的联合关联
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究（n=1,050）发现，在接受住院康复的亚急性幕上缺血性卒中患者中，睡眠呼吸障碍和脑小血管疾病负担与较低的执行功能、较差的平衡能力和较高的住院跌倒风险存在联合关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large retrospective cohort study highlights the association between sleep-disordered breathing, cerebral small vessel disease burden, and executive function, balance, and in-hospital falls in stroke patients. You need to consider these comorbidities more in your assessment and intervention for stroke patients.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性队列研究，只能揭示关联性，不能确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective cohort study, which can only reveal associations and cannot establish causality.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Complete Guide to Clean Claims for Rehab Therapy Billing
items.summary: This guide by WebPT provides a complete overview of the claims creation process to help rehabilitation therapy clinics achieve clean claims and reduce denials.
items.curatedReason: 这份指南提供了物理治疗索赔清算流程的全面指导，能够显著提高你的诊所营收。通过优化索赔提交，你能减少拒付并确保收入稳定。
items.titleZh: 康复治疗账单“洁净索赔”完整指南
items.summaryZh: WebPT 发布了一份关于康复治疗账单“洁净索赔”的完整指南，旨在帮助诊所优化索赔创建流程，提高首次通过率，从而确保收入稳定并减少拒付。
items.curatedReasonEn: This guide provides comprehensive instructions for streamlining physical therapy claims, which can significantly boost your clinic's revenue. By optimizing claim submissions, you can reduce denials and ensure stable income.

items.title: Epidemiological burden and associated factors of shoulder problems in indoor competitive volleyball players: a systematic review
items.summary: A systematic review on shoulder problems in indoor competitive volleyball players, published in BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation, details the epidemiological burden and associated factors of these injuries.
items.curatedReason: 排球运动员肩部问题的流行病学数据是你在评估和管理这类损伤时的重要参考。了解相关危险因素，能帮助你更好地进行预防和早期干预。
items.titleZh: 室内竞技排球运动员肩部问题的流行病学负担及相关因素：系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项发表在《BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation》的系统综述，详细阐述了室内竞技排球运动员肩部问题的流行病学负担及相关因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: The high incidence and associated risk factors for shoulder problems in volleyball players are crucial for your assessment and management of these injuries. Using this epidemiological data will help you more effectively prevent and intervene early.
items.limitation: 系统综述存在纳入研究异质性高的普遍局限，可能影响流行病学数据的精确性。
items.limitationEn: Systematic reviews commonly have limitations due to high heterogeneity among included studies, which may affect the precision of epidemiological data.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: What is the impact of CRP, hs-CRP, IL-6, IL-10, and TNFα in physical performance in community-dwelling older adults: a systematic review
items.summary: A systematic review published in BMC Geriatrics investigated the impact of inflammatory biomarkers (CRP, hs-CRP, IL-6, IL-10, and TNFα) on physical performance in community-dwelling older adults.
items.curatedReason: 炎症生物标志物与社区老年人身体表现之间的关联，是你在评估老年患者衰弱风险时应考虑的重要因素。结合这些指标，你能更全面地进行风险评估和干预计划。
items.titleZh: CRP、hs-CRP、IL-6、IL-10 和 TNFα 对社区老年人身体表现的影响：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项发表在《BMC Geriatrics》的系统综述，探讨了 CRP、hs-CRP、IL-6、IL-10 和 TNFα 等炎症生物标志物对社区老年人身体表现的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: The association between inflammatory biomarkers and physical performance in community-dwelling older adults is a crucial factor to consider when assessing frailty risk in elderly patients. Integrating these indicators allows for a more comprehensive risk assessment and intervention planning.
items.limitation: 作为系统综述，其结论受限于纳入研究的异质性与质量。
items.limitationEn: As a systematic review, its conclusions are limited by the heterogeneity and quality of the included studies.

items.title: The effect of combining visuo-vestibular exercises with manual therapy and exercise on sensorimotor function in chronic neck pain: A randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial with 58 adults with chronic neck pain found that adding visuo-vestibular exercises to manual therapy and exercise resulted in superior improvements in sensorimotor function, pain, balance, and functional disability at 6 and 12 weeks.
items.curatedReason: 针对慢性颈痛，视动-前庭练习与常规手法治疗及运动相结合，能带来更好的感觉运动功能改善。对于那些常规治疗效果不佳的慢性颈痛患者，你应考虑加入视动-前庭练习。
items.titleZh: 视动-前庭练习与手法治疗及运动结合对慢性颈痛感觉运动功能的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 58 名慢性颈痛成年人的随机对照试验显示，在标准手法治疗和运动基础上增加视动-前庭练习，能在 6 周和 12 周时显著改善感觉运动功能、疼痛、平衡和功能障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: For chronic neck pain, combining visuo-vestibular exercises with standard manual therapy and exercise leads to superior sensorimotor function improvements. You should consider adding visuo-vestibular exercises for chronic neck pain patients who show insufficient progress with conventional treatments.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（58名），且随访期相对较短（12周），长期效果仍需更大规模研究验证。
items.limitationEn: This study has a relatively small sample size (58 participants) and a short follow-up period (12 weeks); long-term effects require larger-scale validation.

items.title: Evaluating the impact of high dose inpatient rehabilitation gait training on post stroke physical activity: A secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A secondary analysis of an RCT found that higher doses of inpatient step training in subacute stroke patients impacted physical activity levels 12 months post-stroke, and walking improvements during rehabilitation predicted 12-month physical activity.
items.curatedReason: 高剂量的住院步态训练在卒中后 12 个月仍能维持患者的体力活动水平。这提示早期强化康复的长期价值，可以将其作为转诊和治疗计划的有力依据。
items.titleZh: 高剂量住院步态训练对卒中后体力活动的影响：一项随机对照试验的二次分析
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验的二次分析显示，针对卒中后亚急性期患者的高剂量住院步态训练，能够影响患者卒中后 12 个月的体力活动水平，且康复期间的步行改善可预测 12 个月的体力活动。
items.curatedReasonEn: High-dose inpatient gait training sustains physical activity levels 12 months post-stroke, suggesting the long-term value of early intensive rehabilitation. Use this as strong evidence for referral and treatment planning.
items.limitation: 这是一项针对特定亚急性期卒中患者的二次分析，结果外推需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This is a secondary analysis of a specific subacute stroke population, requiring cautious extrapolation.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Region-specific hamstring activation and its dissociation from subjective contraction sensation during leg curl exercise at different hip flexion angles
items.summary: A study in BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation investigated region-specific hamstring activation and its dissociation from subjective contraction sensation during leg curl exercise at different hip flexion angles.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提供了踇绳肌在不同髋关节屈曲角度下区域激活的实证数据。在设计针对性踇绳肌训练时，你应考虑这些区域激活差异，以优化训练效果。
items.titleZh: 不同髋关节屈曲角度下腘绳肌区域激活及其与主观收缩感知的差异
items.summaryZh: 《BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation》上的一项研究探讨了在不同髋关节屈曲角度下，腿弯举运动中腘绳肌的区域激活及其与主观收缩感知之间的差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study provides empirical data on region-specific hamstring activation at different hip flexion angles. When designing targeted hamstring training, you should consider these regional activation differences to optimize training effectiveness.
items.limitation: 研究观察的是急性效应而非长期训练适应性，结果外推到训练方案设计需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study observed acute effects rather than long-term training adaptations, so results should be cautiously extrapolated to exercise program design.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Sex- and age-specific risk factors for possible sarcopenic obesity in community-dwelling older adults: a cross-sectional study
items.summary: A cross-sectional study in BMC Geriatrics identified sex- and age-specific risk factors for possible sarcopenic obesity in community-dwelling older adults.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究指出了社区老年人肌少性肥胖在性别和年龄上的特异性危险因素。你在评估老年患者时，应根据这些因素进行更精细的风险分层，以实现早期识别和干预。
items.titleZh: 社区老年人潜在肌少性肥胖的性别和年龄特异性危险因素：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项发表在《BMC Geriatrics》的横断面研究，揭示了社区老年人潜在肌少性肥胖的性别和年龄特异性危险因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study identifies sex- and age-specific risk factors for sarcopenic obesity in community-dwelling older adults. When assessing elderly patients, you should use these factors for more precise risk stratification, enabling earlier identification and intervention.
items.limitation: 作为一项横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，仅能提示相关性。
items.limitationEn: As a cross-sectional study, it cannot establish causality, only suggest associations.

items.title: Gait adaptations and spinal curvature correlations following lumbar arthrodesis: an analytic cross-sectional study
items.summary: A cross-sectional study in BMC Musculoskeletal Disorders investigated gait adaptations and spinal curvature correlations following lumbar arthrodesis.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究揭示了腰椎关节融合术后步态适应和脊柱曲度之间的关联。你在评估这类术后患者时，应综合考虑步态模式和脊柱生物力学变化，以指导康复方案设计。
items.titleZh: 腰椎关节融合术后步态适应与脊柱曲度相关性：一项分析性横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 《BMC Musculoskeletal Disorders》上的一项横断面研究，探讨了腰椎关节融合术后步态适应与脊柱曲度之间的相关性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals the correlations between gait adaptations and spinal curvature following lumbar arthrodesis. When assessing such postoperative patients, you should comprehensively consider gait patterns and spinal biomechanical changes to guide rehabilitation program design.
items.limitation: 作为横断面研究，无法确定因果关系，也无法评估长期随访效果。
items.limitationEn: As a cross-sectional study, it cannot establish causality or assess long-term follow-up effects.

items.title: Growing Our Impact and Advancing Pediatric Physical Therapy.
items.summary: This publication is the official journal of the Section on Pediatrics of the American Physical Therapy Association.
items.curatedReason: 儿科物理治疗领域正在快速发展，需要你关注其对实践的影响和专业发展方向。这份社论的讨论焦点提醒我们，该领域正面临提升服务影响力和专业能力的双重挑战。
items.titleZh: 扩展我们的影响并推进儿科物理治疗
items.summaryZh: 美国物理治疗协会儿科分会官方刊物的一篇社论讨论了儿科物理治疗领域如何扩展其影响力和促进专业发展。
items.curatedReasonEn: Pediatric physical therapy is evolving rapidly; you need to consider its impact on practice and professional development. This editorial’s discussion points highlight the dual challenge of enhancing service impact and professional competence in the field.
items.journal: Pediatric physical therapy : the official publication of the Section on Pediatrics of the American Physical Therapy Association

items.title: Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation for Dizziness, Balance, and Postural Stability in Adult Patients With Chronic Peripheral Vestibular Dizziness.
items.summary: A double-blind RCT (N=56) found that repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) combined with vestibular rehabilitation (VR) significantly improved dizziness, balance, and postural stability in adults with chronic peripheral vestibular dizziness, compared to sham rTMS plus VR over 8 weeks.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 证据提示，对于慢性前庭性眩晕，经颅重复磁刺激（rTMS）结合前庭康复（VR）可能优于单纯 VR 疗法，为你的干预方案提供了新的联合治疗思路。
items.titleZh: 重复经颅磁刺激治疗慢性外周前庭性眩晕成人患者的眩晕、平衡和姿势稳定性
items.summaryZh: 一项双盲随机对照试验（N=56）发现，与安慰剂刺激加前庭康复相比，重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）结合前庭康复（VR）在 8 周内显著改善了慢性外周前庭性眩晕成人患者的眩晕、平衡和姿势稳定性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) combined with vestibular rehabilitation (VR) may be superior to VR alone for chronic peripheral vestibular dizziness, offering a new combination therapy approach for your intervention strategies.
items.limitation: 研究未详细说明患者病程范围，可能存在异质性对结果的影响，同时长期随访数据有待观察。
items.limitationEn: The study did not detail the full range of patient disease duration, which might introduce heterogeneity, and long-term follow-up data are needed.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Effects of a Virtual Reality-Based Balance Training Program on Clinical Outcomes and Cortical Oscillatory Activity: A Combined Behavioral and EEG Study.
items.summary: This single-group study (N=28 subacute stroke survivors) found that 12 VR-based balance training sessions over 4 weeks improved clinical mobility outcomes and altered resting EEG activity.
items.curatedReason: VR 余额训练在亚急性卒中患者中展现了改善平衡和皮质活动的前景，但单组设计限制了结论强度，还需要进一步的 RCT 验证其优效性。
items.titleZh: 虚拟现实平衡训练对临床结果和皮质振荡活动的影响：一项行为与脑电图结合研究
items.summaryZh: 一项单组研究（28 名亚急性卒中幸存者）发现，为期 4 周的 12 次 VR 平衡训练课程改善了临床活动能力结果并改变了静息脑电图活动。
items.curatedReasonEn: VR-based balance training shows promise in improving balance and cortical activity in subacute stroke survivors. However, the single-group design limits the strength of conclusions; further RCTs are needed to confirm its efficacy.
items.limitation: 本研究为单组重复测量设计，缺乏对照组，无法排除安慰剂效应或自然恢复的影响。
items.limitationEn: This study used a single-group repeated-measures design, lacking a control group to rule out placebo effects or natural recovery.

items.title: Influence of knee hyperextension persisting into preswing on swing-phase kinematics through forward propulsion in poststroke hemiparetic gait.
items.summary: This observational study (N=30 chronic poststroke hemiparesis patients) investigated the influence of knee hyperextension persisting into preswing on swing-phase kinematics and forward propulsion.
items.curatedReason: 有卒中后偏瘫患者的步态中膝关节过伸问题？这项观察研究（N=30）提示，过伸持续到摆动前期，确实可能损害摆动期的肢体缩短，并降低向前推进力。这意味着处理膝过伸，不仅是外观问题，更是步态效率的关键。
items.titleZh: 卒中后偏瘫步态中膝关节过伸持续至摆动前期对前推进力摆动期运动学的影响
items.summaryZh: 这项观察性研究（N=30 名慢性卒中后偏瘫患者）调查了膝关节过伸持续至摆动前期对摆动期运动学和前推进力的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: For your post-stroke hemiparesis patients, persistent knee hyperextension into preswing might be more than just an aesthetic issue. This observational study (N=30) suggests it could impair swing-phase limb shortening and reduce forward propulsion, making effective intervention on hyperextension crucial for gait efficiency.
items.limitation: 作为观察性研究，本研究仅能揭示相关性，无法确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: As an observational study, it can only identify correlations and cannot establish causality.

items.title: Quality indicators for Spanish hospital-based physical therapy units: a feasibility and inter-rater reliability study.
items.summary: This multicentre observational study in Spain evaluated the feasibility and inter-rater reliability of 22 quality indicators for hospital-based physical therapy units, finding 13 were feasible and reliable.
items.curatedReason: 西班牙医院物理治疗单位的质量指标研究，验证了 13 项指标的可行性和评估者间信度。这为你在设计单位内部质量管理和绩效评估体系时提供了参考，但注意地理和医疗系统差异。
items.titleZh: 西班牙医院物理治疗单位质量指标的的可行性与评估者间信度研究
items.summaryZh: 这项在西班牙进行的多中心观察性研究评估了医院物理治疗单位 22 项质量指标的可行性和评估者间信度，发现其中 13 项可行且可靠。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study on quality indicators for Spanish hospital PT units validated 13 indicators for feasibility and inter-rater reliability. It offers a reference for designing internal quality management and performance assessment systems, but consider geographical and healthcare system differences.
items.limitation: 本研究为描述性观察研究，仅在西班牙三家医院进行，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This descriptive observational study was conducted in only three hospitals in Spain, limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Rapid growth in autism spectrum disorder referrals reshaped rehabilitation service use: A longitudinal cohort study of children and adolescents in Brazil
items.summary: This retrospective longitudinal cohort study in Brazil analyzed how a rapid growth in autism spectrum disorder (ASD) referrals reshaped rehabilitation service use for children and adolescents between 2017-2026.
items.curatedReason: 巴西的这项队列研究揭示了自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）转诊的快速增长如何重塑康复服务需求。它提醒你注意 ASD 患者量增加对康复资源分配的潜在压力，以及在资源有限地区服务模式可能面临的挑战。
items.titleZh: 自闭症谱系障碍转诊量的快速增长重塑了康复服务的使用：一项巴西儿童和青少年纵向队列研究
items.summaryZh: 这项在巴西进行的追溯性纵向队列研究分析了 2017-2026 年间自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）转诊量的快速增长如何重塑了儿童和青少年的康复服务使用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Brazilian cohort study reveals how the rapid growth in autism spectrum disorder (ASD) referrals is reshaping rehabilitation service demand. It highlights potential pressures on rehabilitation resource allocation due to increasing ASD patient volumes and the challenges service models may face in resource-limited regions.
items.limitation: 本研究基于单一康复中心数据，可能存在选择偏倚，且结果外推至其他国家或地区需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This study is based on data from a single rehabilitation center, which may introduce selection bias, and generalizing the results to other countries or regions should be done with caution.

items.title: Clinical practice guideline for physical therapist management of total knee arthroplasty: revision 2026.
items.summary: The American Physical Therapy Association (APTA) has released a revised clinical practice guideline for physical therapist management of total knee arthroplasty, based on a systematic review of current scientific literature, featuring 20 recommendations.
items.curatedReason: 这份 APTA 指南更新了 TKA 术后康复的 20 条建议，直接取代旧版。它囊括了所有 PT 在 TKA 围手术期管理的证据，是你日常实践的权威参考，不看会吃亏。
items.titleZh: 全膝关节置换术物理治疗管理临床实践指南：2026 年修订版
items.summaryZh: 美国物理治疗协会 (APTA) 发布了全膝关节置换术 (TKA) 物理治疗管理临床实践指南的修订版，该指南基于对当前科学文献的系统综述，提出了 20 项建议。
items.curatedReasonEn: This updated APTA guideline offers 20 new recommendations for TKA rehab, directly superseding previous versions. It consolidates all evidence for PT management in the perioperative TKA period, making it an authoritative, indispensable resource for your daily practice.

items.title: Effects of Short-term High-intensity vs. Moderate-intensity Interval Training on Cardiopulmonary Fitness and Metabolic Health in Overweight or Obese Patients with Cardiovascular Disease: Evidence from China.
items.summary: A retrospective study in China involving 145 overweight or obese patients with cardiovascular disease found that 4-week supervised high-intensity interval training (HIIT) was more effective than moderate-intensity interval training (MIIT) in improving cardiopulmonary fitness.
items.curatedReason: 对于超重或肥胖心血管疾病患者，短期高强度间歇训练 (HIIT) 在改善心肺功能方面优于中等强度间歇训练 (MIIT)。在条件允许下，可考虑将 HIIT 纳入这些患者的康复方案，但注意其回顾性研究设计的局限。
items.titleZh: 短期高强度与中等强度间歇训练对超重或肥胖心血管疾病患者心肺适能和代谢健康的影响：来自中国的证据
items.summaryZh: 一项在中国进行的回顾性研究显示，在 145 名超重或肥胖心血管疾病患者中，为期 4 周的监督式高强度间歇训练 (HIIT) 在改善心肺适能方面优于中等强度间歇训练 (MIIT)。
items.curatedReasonEn: For overweight or obese patients with cardiovascular disease, short-term high-intensity interval training (HIIT) shows superior cardiopulmonary fitness improvements compared to moderate-intensity interval training (MIIT). Consider incorporating HIIT into rehabilitation programs for these patients where appropriate, while being mindful of the limitations of its retrospective design.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性设计，存在选择偏倚和混杂因素的风险，且研究人群仅限于中国患者，结果的外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective study carries risks of selection bias and confounding factors, and its findings are limited to a Chinese patient population, restricting generalizability.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Models Containing the Braden Scale Predict Activities of Daily Living Improvement in Post-Stroke Hemiplegia: A Single Center Retrospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study of 324 patients with post-stroke hemiplegia found that models incorporating the Braden scale could predict activities of daily living (ADL) improvement.
items.curatedReason: 布雷登量表通常用于评估压疮风险，但这项研究提示它可能也能作为预测卒中偏瘫患者 ADL 恢复的有效组成部分。你可以考虑在康复初期将布雷登量表整合到你的预后评估模型中。
items.titleZh: 包含布雷登量表的模型可预测卒中偏瘫患者日常生活活动能力（ADL）的改善：一项单中心回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 324 名卒中偏瘫患者进行的回顾性队列研究发现，包含布雷登量表的模型能够预测其日常生活活动能力（ADL）的改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Braden scale is typically used for pressure ulcer risk, but this study suggests it could be an effective component for predicting ADL recovery in post-stroke hemiplegia. You might consider integrating the Braden scale into your prognostic assessment models in early rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心回顾性研究，可能存在选择偏倚和数据完整性问题。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center retrospective study, which may introduce selection bias and data integrity issues.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Sensory integration strategies for static balance control in older adults with knee osteoarthritis.
items.summary: A repeated-measures study on 69 older adults with knee osteoarthritis investigated sensory integration strategies for static balance control, assessing proprioceptive, visual, and vestibular contributions.
items.curatedReason: 对于膝骨关节炎老年患者，保持静态平衡需要整合本体感觉、视觉和前庭系统。这项纳入 69 人的观察研究提示，在平衡训练中你需要考虑患者在这些感觉输入上的个体差异。
items.titleZh: 膝骨关节炎老年患者静态平衡控制中的感觉整合策略
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 69 名膝骨关节炎老年患者的重复测量研究，调查了静态平衡控制中的感觉整合策略，评估了本体感觉、视觉和前庭感觉的贡献。
items.curatedReasonEn: Static balance in older adults with knee osteoarthritis relies on the integration of proprioceptive, visual, and vestibular systems. This observational study of 69 individuals suggests you should consider individual differences in these sensory inputs when designing balance training.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心研究，可能限制了结果的外推性。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center study, which may limit the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Hydrodilatation for adhesive capsulitis: a systematic review exploring efficacy and optimal technique.
items.summary: This systematic review and meta-analysis of 103 studies (9951 patients, 44 RCTs) found that hydrodilatation for adhesive capsulitis provides superior short-term pain relief over corticosteroid injection or placebo, but long-term outcomes (12-24 weeks) are comparable to physical therapy.
items.curatedReason: 针对粘连性囊炎，水扩张术在高强度疼痛期短期疗效优于单独类固醇注射或安慰剂，但在长期（12-24 周）与物理治疗效果相当。在考虑使用水扩张术时，你仍需搭配物理治疗以实现更持久的改善，且容量在 20-50 mL 范围内的文献支持较多。
items.titleZh: 粘连性囊炎的水扩张术：系统综述探讨疗效与最佳技术
items.summaryZh: 这项纳入 103 项研究（9951 例患者，44 项 RCT）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，水扩张术治疗粘连性囊炎短期镇痛效果优于单独类固醇注射或安慰剂，但长期（12-24 周）疗效与物理治疗相似。
items.curatedReasonEn: For adhesive capsulitis, hydrodilatation offers short-term superior pain relief during acute phases compared to corticosteroid injections alone or placebo, but its long-term efficacy (12-24 weeks) is comparable to physical therapy. When considering hydrodilatation, you should still integrate physical therapy for sustained improvements, with volumes of 20-50 mL having the most evidence.
items.limitation: 尽管纳入大量研究，但研究异质性高，且大部分证据等级为中低，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: Despite a large number of included studies, high heterogeneity and mostly moderate-to-low quality evidence may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Spine-related leg pain: Definitions, etiology, clinical presentation, and management.
items.summary: The International Association for the Study of Pain (IASP) has distinguished three categories of spine-related leg pain (SRLP): radiculopathy, radicular pain, and somatic referred pain, addressing inconsistent terminology and treatment variability in lumbar spine disorders.
items.curatedReason: 国际疼痛学会（IASP）对脊柱相关腿痛（SRLP）的分类更新强调了对根性痛、神经根病和躯体转诊痛的精确区分，这有助于你提升诊断准确性并优化治疗方案。理解这些新定义将直接影响你对腰椎疾病患者的评估和干预决策，避免不精确的“坐骨神经痛”标签。
items.titleZh: 脊柱相关腿痛：定义、病因、临床表现与管理
items.summaryZh: 国际疼痛学会（IASP）已将脊柱相关腿痛（SRLP）分为三个类别：神经根病、根性痛和躯体转诊痛，旨在解决腰椎疾病中术语不一致和治疗差异大的问题。
items.curatedReasonEn: The updated IASP classification for Spine-Related Leg Pain (SRLP) emphasizes precise differentiation among radicular pain, radiculopathy, and somatic referred pain, which will enhance your diagnostic accuracy and optimize treatment strategies. Understanding these new definitions will directly impact your assessment and intervention decisions for lumbar spine patients, moving beyond imprecise labels like “sciatica.”

items.title: The effects of a falls prevention app (SAFE app) on community-dwelling adults' fall risk category: Single-blinded randomized control pilot trial.
items.summary: A single-blinded randomized controlled pilot trial (N=54) found that a 12-week app-based home exercise program improved fall risk measures and increased adherence rates in community-dwelling adults aged 65 and older.
items.curatedReason: 针对社区老年人的跌倒预防，这款基于 App 的家庭运动计划在试点 RCT 中展现出改善跌倒风险和提高依从性的潜力。你可以将其作为未来远程健康或辅助干预的参考，但请注意其样本量较小，需等待更大规模研究验证其普适性。
items.titleZh: 跌倒预防 App (SAFE app) 对社区老年人跌倒风险类别的效果：单盲随机对照试点试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 65 岁以上社区老年人（N=54）的单盲随机对照试点试验显示，为期 12 周的基于 App 的家庭运动计划能改善跌倒风险指标并提高依从性。
items.curatedReasonEn: For falls prevention in community-dwelling older adults, this app-based home exercise program showed potential in a pilot RCT to improve fall risk and adherence. You can consider this as a reference for future telehealth or adjunctive interventions, but note its small sample size; await larger studies for generalizability.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本（N=54）的试点研究，且干预时间较短（12 周），外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a small-sample (N=54) pilot study with a short intervention period (12 weeks), limiting its generalizability.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: Effectiveness of an individualised swimming and education programme for chronic low back pain (EduSwim): a randomised controlled trial.
items.summary: This is a protocol for a randomized controlled trial (EduSwim) to assess the effectiveness of an individualized swimming and education program, delivered via telehealth, compared to education alone for chronic non-specific low back pain.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT的方案预发表，将评估个性化游泳结合教育项目对慢性下腰痛的有效性。如果结果积极，它能为下腰痛的运动处方提供新的循证支持。
items.titleZh: 个性化游泳结合教育项目治疗慢性下腰痛的有效性（EduSwim）：一项随机对照试验方案
items.summaryZh: 这是一项随机对照试验（EduSwim）的方案，旨在评估通过远程物理治疗提供的个性化游泳和教育项目，与单纯教育相比，对慢性非特异性下腰痛患者的有效性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pre-published RCT protocol will evaluate the effectiveness of an individualized swimming and education program for chronic low back pain. If the results are positive, it could provide new evidence-based support for exercise prescription in LBP.

items.title: Effect of resistance, balance, and aerobic training on strength, mobility, balance, and quality of life in older adults with sarcopenia: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis found that resistance, balance, and aerobic training significantly improve strength, mobility, balance, and quality of life in older adults with sarcopenia.
items.curatedReason: 对肌少症老年人，综合性抗阻、平衡和有氧训练方案是明确的一线干预。这项高质量系统综述和荟萃分析确认其能显著改善力量、活动度、平衡和生活质量。
items.titleZh: 抗阻、平衡和有氧训练对肌少症老年人力量、活动度、平衡和生活质量的影响：系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析发现，抗阻、平衡和有氧训练能显著改善肌少症老年人的力量、活动度、平衡能力和生活质量。
items.curatedReasonEn: For older adults with sarcopenia, a comprehensive program of resistance, balance, and aerobic training is a clear first-line intervention. This high-quality systematic review and meta-analysis confirms its significant benefits on strength, mobility, balance, and quality of life.
items.limitation: 荟萃分析的异质性可能影响结果的总体适用性，且特定训练方案的剂量-反应关系有待进一步明确。
items.limitationEn: Heterogeneity within the meta-analysis may affect the generalizability of results, and the dose-response relationship for specific training programs needs further clarification.
